name: Lead by Example (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
You have a talent for sharing your skills with others.

Prerequisite(s): Any teamwork feat

Benefit(s): You may spend 10 minutes each morning preparing your party to work together. Choose a number of creatures equal to your Intelligence or Wisdom modifier, whichever is greater. Those creatures gain limited use of one of your teamwork feats, even if they do not meet the prerequisites. Until the affected creatures rest for 8 hours they may use the chosen teamwork feat for 10 minutes as a free action. These 10 minutes need not be consecutive, but must be used in 1 minute increments. A creature can only be affected by one instance of this feat at a time. This feat counts as Combat Expertise and Intelligence 13 for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.
